data.gender_notes: Bhavna is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhavna is a Sanskrit name for 'feeling', 'emotion', or 'sentiment'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'bhav', which means 'to be'. In Hindu mythology, Bhavna represents the emotional aspect of the universe and is believed to be a powerful influence on the human experience. The name Bhavna carries the meaning “Feeling, Emotion, Sentiment” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhavna usually hope their child will grow to embody feeling, emotion, sentiment and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhavna total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
